name: outline-card
about: A new document's outline before the writing, on a real model (16 Nov 2026, chat/cards/outline.rs; built 15 Nov in #129, checked then only on --fake). Any model: a plan chat's create_document comes over Yap's run endpoint since 16 Nov (claude_live/documents.rs), the tool loop's on `--model ondevice` (the on-device Qwen on this PC, through a llama-server you started: YAP_LAB_LOCAL_LLM; free), an API model, or --fake. Chat is asked for a short guide; its create_document comes to the person as a card first — nothing written — then Edit's Go with a section renamed and one taken out, and a note; the document is made with those sections, in that order.

steps.note: On by default in the app; the e2e suite's base config has it off.

steps.ask: Write me a short document: a beginner's guide to composting at home, in three sections. Make it a document beside the chat.

steps.note: The outline first: a card in the thread, the turn waiting.

with.note: Keep each section to a few short lines.

steps.note: Edit: the first renamed, the last taken out, a note for the writing.
The model's result says the person changed the outline (data.outline), so it writes those sections.
